title: Inter: 10 Press Reports This Week, Only 1 Held Up | Nerazzurri Daily
description:
The Italian papers printed 10 reports about Inter this week. One held up, nine are still open.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=82

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Zieliński stayed with Poland: La Gazzetta dello Sport reported it (Nov 16); Inter.it says he captained Poland in a 1–1 draw with Sweden (Nov 17).
REPORTED — Lautaro Martínez on the bench in Bergamo: Tuttosport (Nov 18) and Corriere dello Sport (Nov 20, Nov 22). The club has not said. Still open.
REPORTED — Çalhanoğlu renewal talks: Corriere dello Sport says Inter offered a lower fixed salary with richer bonuses; his contract runs to 2027 (Nov 19). Still open.
THE TALLY — 1 of 10 reported items confirmed, 9 still open, none denied. Editions No. 76 to No. 82.
NEXT — Atalanta vs Inter today, Sun, Nov 22, 2:45 PM ET, 20:45 CET, Serie A matchday 12. US TV: Paramount+.
